content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Pensacola

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Verify you meet PMI's education and project-management experience requirements for the PMP credential. Review the specific hour thresholds based on your degree level. Granite PM Academy's advisors can clarify your qualification status before enrollment.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Boot Camp. Attend all sessions synchronously with experienced instructors and fellow Pensacola professionals. You'll earn the 35 PMI contact hours required to apply for the PMP exam.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After course completion, submit your formal PMP application directly to PMI. Include your education credentials, work experience details, and proof of the 35 contact hours from Granite PM Academy. Pay the PMI examination fee when you file.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources, practice tests, and instructor guidance to build confidence. Schedule your exam through Pearson VUE at a local testing center. Sit for the four-hour, computer-based PMP examination on your chosen date.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP, commit to the three-year renewal cycle by earning Professional Development Units (PDUs) through training, volunteer work, and professional engagement. Granite PM Academy offers continuing education to help you stay current and compliant.
